result.title: Put your dot on call
result.description:
Ali, an engineer at OpenAI, used his dot to triage an on-call incident at 3am.
 
His dot investigated the issue and started a Codex thread, so he could steer the work from his phone in the ChatGPT app.

result.title: How teams can automate recurring tasks with ChatGPT
result.description:
Set up recurring work your team can manage together with team tasks in ChatGPT. Follow a legal team's daily intake workflow—from reviewing incoming requests and checking deadlines to refining shared instructions for the next run.

Tasks run in the cloud, so teammates can review results, improve the workflow, and keep work moving when someone is away.

Available to Enterprise plans
